answer: An escrowed referral graph stops hollow shell identities. Each newcomer posts a 40-credit bond and names a sponsor, whose stake is slashed too if it cheats. Every identity is a vertex in a graph, and an orchard of fakes under one sponsor shows as a star. Peers can dispute a vertex; a confirmed dispute burns the bond plus the sponsor's 20 credits. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its bond.
